rule: Every canonical shared subsystem listed here must be REACHABLE from each declared required surface through its real public seam. A subsystem that exists on one required surface but not another is an INVALID repository state: CI fails. Reachability is verified by the named required_tests, which must enter through the production entry points (not bypass helpers).

canonical_pipeline_boundary.rule: The canonical shared pipeline BEGINS at decoded PCM + native sample rate. Media DECODING is surface-specific and legitimately NOT shared: Python may use librosa/soundfile, the browser may use Web Audio (decodeAudioData / MediaStream). What must be identical is everything downstream: native-rate PCM enters runtime-core (AnalysisTimebase) and the Rust StreamingResampler owns ALL rate conversion on every surface. Never pre-resample in Python (librosa sr=SAMPLE_RATE) or in TypeScript before the timebase — that reintroduces a second resampler authority.
canonical_pipeline_boundary.phase_critical_note: For phase-critical file-mode comparisons, use PCM/WAV fixtures: MP3/AAC decoders apply codec-specific priming/delay that shifts sample alignment between decoders. Live microphone input is already PCM, so the issue does not exist there.
canonical_pipeline_boundary.ingestion_contract: decoded PCM (native rate) + native sample rate -> runtime-core AnalysisTimebase.ingest(samples, source_sample_rate, source_start_frame)

audio_analysis.description: Canonical 48 kHz sample-clock timebase: exactly-once PCM ingestion, stateful resampling, 1024-sample hop scheduling, epoch semantics, feature extraction.

physics_step.description: c-space physics integration. The timestep must come from the canonical tick contract (AnalysisTick.dt_seconds = HOP_LENGTH / SAMPLE_RATE), never restated as a literal.

surfaces.training_surface: backend/src/cspace_proxies.py (differentiable mirrors) consuming dt from the canonical tick contract

cycle_bank.authority: runtime-core/src/cycle_bank.rs (CycleBank, CycleMode, CycleObservation, CycleRelation) with the canonical seam runtime-core/src/timebase.rs::cycle_observation_from_tick
cycle_bank.description: Causal multiscale observed-ridge timing (issue #92, ADR 0003; supersedes ADR 0002): one scalar per evidence channel per authoritative hop -> causal constant-Q analytic field -> continuous off-grid frequency/phase -> persistent observed CycleModes + rational-relation diagnostics. The newest-frame extraction from the overlapping feature window lives in Rust only. No global tempo, no beat/bar/phrase trackers, no latent undertones (#97).

surfaces.runtime_surface: wasm-orbit/src/lib.rs (CycleBank wasm_bindgen, observe_tick) consumed via the generated CycleMode/CycleRelation TypeScript interfaces

controls_v2.authority: runtime-core/src/controls.rs (ControlsV2, MotionControls, JuliaViewControls, JuliaViewState, ColorIntent, Harmony; CONTROLS_VERSION controls/2)
controls_v2.description: Unified Controls v2 action surface (issue #107): 2-DOF manifold drive as generalized forces/impulses/PSD friction plus bounded Julia view deltas over persistent ColorIntent/Harmony. Rust owns ranges, normalization, and state integration; Python/WASM bindings are thin projections; ONNX metadata stamps controls_version and parameter_names from Rust authority.

surfaces.runtime_surface: wasm-orbit/src/lib.rs (ControlsV2/MotionControls/JuliaViewControls/JuliaViewState/ColorIntent wasm_bindgen) consumed by frontend/src/lib/modelInference.ts + frontend/src/lib/orbitSynthesizer.ts (stepWithControls)
surfaces.training_surface: runtime-core/src/pybindings.rs (ControlsV2 PyO3) consumed by backend/src/control_model.py + backend/src/export_model.py + backend/train.py (controls_version gate)

model_io.authority: runtime-core/src/model_io.rs (model-io/1 schemas, routing, decoders, and visual/drive projections)
model_io.description: Canonical interpretation of post-activation model outputs. Rust owns output ordering, head activation descriptors, legacy orbit and visual decoding, audio summary slots, runtime routing, and the product-level visual/drive projections used after ONNX inference.

surfaces.runtime_surface: wasm-orbit/src/lib.rs compiled model_io JSON bindings consumed by frontend/src/lib/modelInference.ts
surfaces.training_surface: runtime-core/src/pybindings.rs model_io JSON bindings consumed by backend/src/control_model.py and backend/src/export_model.py

manifold_physics.authority: runtime-core/src/manifold.rs (ManifoldConfig, induced_metric, Christoffel, integrate_step, EnergyInfo; embedding/Jacobian/q_dot/sigma_dot)
manifold_physics.description: Mandelbrot-native manifold Physics (issue #106): embedding q(c)=(x,y,sigma(c)), Jacobian, metric G, potential U=kappa*sigma, Levi-Civita connection, energy ledger, musically-ignorant generalized-force integration. D/d/S distinct, no v_sigma.

surfaces.runtime_surface: wasm-orbit/src/lib.rs (manifold_* wasm_bindgen incl embedding/jacobian/q_dot/sigma_dot/unsigned_distance) consumed by frontend/src/lib/orbitSynthesizer.ts (stepWithControls)
surfaces.training_surface: runtime-core/src/pybindings.rs (manifold_* PyO3) consumed by backend/src/cspace_proxies.py (manifold_integrate_step mirror) and backend/src/control_model.py

binding_symmetry.rule: Every pyclass exported through runtime-core/src/pybindings.rs must have a wasm_bindgen export in wasm-orbit/src/lib.rs, and vice versa, unless exempted below. A canonical subsystem exported to only one consumer surface is the #93 failure mode.

exemption_reasons.RuntimeVisualMetrics: Training-only diagnostic; the browser computes visual metrics in TypeScript.
exemption_reasons.Complex: wasm-only serialization helper, not a canonical subsystem.
exemption_reasons.CycleMode: PyO3 read-only view object; the browser consumes the equivalent record via the Rust-authored `CycleMode` TypeScript interface emitted by the wasm custom section. One logical domain type, two surface-idiomatic projections — not a redeclared structural copy.
exemption_reasons.CycleRelation: Read-only record reached as data from CycleBank on both surfaces (PyO3 dict / wasm-generated TS interface), not an independent #[wasm_bindgen] struct.
exemption_reasons.CycleObservation: Binding-layer input DTO; constructed on each surface and passed into the Rust authority, not a tracked domain state type.
exemption_reasons.CycleEvidenceChannel: Binding-layer input DTO, same rationale as CycleObservation.
exemption_reasons.CycleBankConfig: Construction-time configuration DTO; the browser runs canonical defaults and does not need a config object.
exemption_reasons.EnergyInfo: Read-only diagnostic record returned by manifold_integrate_step (issue #106); the wasm surface receives the same five energy scalars flattened into the Array return of manifold_integrate_step. One logical domain payload, two surface-idiomatic projections.
exemption_reasons.PlayerState: Legacy c-space integrator retained for golden_vectors.json parity (issue #107); destination path now uses ControlsV2->manifold physics, but historical vectors still exercise the old servo. Wasm retains binding for frontend compat; Python no longer exports it.
